༄༅/ /gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab ma'i skor las dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab ma'i skor las dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

skyabs sems ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ mchod gtor rnams/ ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rak+ta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pu dza ho: byin gyis brlab/ bdag bskyed ni/ rang nyid skad cig gu ru pad+ma 'byung*// gsang ba'i bdag po dbyer med sku mdog mthing*// rdo rje sdig 'dzub khro bo'i chas kun rdzogs// snang grags lha sngags bde chen rol par gyur// zhes gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru tsan+d+ra ma ha ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla/ oṃ ā mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dha3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las mdun du lcang lo can gyi pho brang bkod pas mdzes pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la skad cig gis/ dzam+bha la ser po g.yas shing thog pu ra ser po/ g.yon ne'u le ma ṇi rat+na skyugs pa/ nor bu'i dbyibs 'dra ba khog stod dar dmar gyis brgyan pa/ khog smad dar ljang gis brgyan pa/ de'i spyi bor rang nyid o rgyan du gyur/ kho yi khog smad dar de las yam̐ gcig chad pas rlung du gyur/ khog stod kyi dar de las ram̐ gcig chad pas me chung ngur gyur/ rlung de je che la byung me la brgyab/ me de che nas khog tu rgyug pas/ kho skom pas rang gi lus las chu babs nas me bsad pas/ kho mgu nas dngos grub ci dgos lags dang sbyin zer te/ nor gyi dngos grub dang gang 'dod brjod pas khos byin par gyur/ bdag thugs 'od zer lcags kyu yis// chos dbyings khyab pa'i zhing khams dang*// lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// nor bdag 'khor bcas spyan drangs bstim// spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: byang phyogs gter gyi gzhal yas na// nor gyi dbang phyug dzam+bha la// thugs rjes gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ji srid bar du brtan par bzhugs// badz+ra sa ma ya dza tiṣ+tha lhan/

mchod pa ni/ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag gi /dpal 'byor blo yis blangs te 'bul// yid sprul rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun// dngos 'byor mchod gtor 'di 'bul bzhes// oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐ bde gshegs sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// gzugs kyi sku sprul dzam+bha la/ dran pa tsam gyis dbul phongs sel// dzam lha ser por phyag 'tshal bstod// bshags pa ni/ thog med ser sna'i las bsags rnams// mthol bshags byang zhing dag gyur cig /dbul phongs thams cad zhi ba dang*// dpal 'byor nor dbyig 'phel zhing rgyas// 'dod dgu snang srid dbang du bsdus// snyigs dus mu ge'i bskal pa zlog /thugs dam dus bab sa ma ya// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ bzlas dmigs ni/ dzaṃ lha'i thugs kar zla gdan la// thugs srog sa bon sngags phreng bcas// rang mdog g.yas bskor 'khod par gyur// bdag thugs 'od kyis mchod pas mnyes// thugs bskyed dam bca' rjes dran te// 'od zer sprul tshogs 'jig rten khyab// mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor longs spyod bsdus// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar gyur// zhes gsal gdab cing*/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ bsnyen sngags ci nus bzlas mthar rjes rim ni/ slar yang*/ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag gi /dpal 'byor blo yis blangs te 'bul// yid sprul rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun// dngos 'byor mchod gtor 'di 'bul bzhes// oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐: bde gshegs sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// gzugs kyi sku sprul dzam+bha la// dran pa tsam gyis dbul phongs sel// dzam lha ser por phyag 'tshal bstod// thog med ser sna'i las bsags rnams// mthol bshags byang zhing dag gyur cig /dbul phongs thams cad zhi ba dang*// dpal 'byor nor dbyig 'phel zhing rgyas// 'dod dgu snang srid dbang du bsdus// snyigs dus mu ge'i bskal pa bzlog

/thugs dam dus bab sa ma ya// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// brtan bzhugs ni/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣ+tha badz+ra ye swā hā/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nor gyi bdag por 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / dge ba bsngo/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// sems can re ba bskang mdzad ltar// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces bkra shis kyi mtha' brgyan cing bdag bskyed dmigs med du bzhag pas grub bo// zhes gnam chos dang rgyal dbang bco lnga pa'i gsung gul dang bstun nas bklag chog tu khra 'gu sprul ming pas nyams len byed po rnams la phan pa'i ched du bris pa dge// /
